confirmed_blockers: The source-order state space omits fenced code and alternate raw-pre states, allowing false references, headings, and operations.
Reference delimiters can pair across opaque or escaped states, suppressing later active candidates.
Thousands of href intervals receive contradictory dispositions, relative CSSWG hrefs are false-excluded, and a bare CSSWG root URL throws.
Carriers are inherited from rejected V1 rather than re-extracted, while raw attribute regexes can fabricate definition target joins.
Line-granular ancestry collapses distinct same-line headings and operations.
Operation discovery is a keyword/tag heuristic rather than a reviewed normative-operation bijection.
Generation, regeneration, and mutation expectations share the same semantic implementation and do not provide an independent relation oracle.
The launcher and imported dependencies are not authenticated at a complete pre-execution boundary, and resource/work/publication evidence is not content-addressed or adversarially closed.
required_next: Form V9 around one byte-positioned and work-bounded source-order state machine; make delimiter formation state-bounded and no-throw; resolve hrefs and enforce one disposition per interval; re-extract every structural family from parsed tokens with byte-position ownership; bind operations to an independent normative ledger; add an independent semantic oracle and invariant-specific mutations; freeze launcher, dependency, resource, and crash evidence; retain every V6-V8 witness; then obtain two fresh challenges and root gestalt.
